individuals.title: Edit Check
individuals.quote: Offer people actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies while they are editing.

individuals.title: Editing Team
individuals.quote: The Editing Team is working on a set of improvements for the visual editor

individuals.title: Multi-Check
individuals.quote: Multi-Check was deployed to all wikis where Reference Check is currently available on June 25, 2025.

individuals.title: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing

individuals.title: Moderators at English and French Wikipedias
individuals.quote: Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making

individuals.title: Feel safe and confident publishing proud changes
individuals.quote: will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of and that experienced volunteers consider useful.

individuals.title: Moderators motivated to configure Edit Check
individuals.quote: be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them.

individuals.title: Editors do not know policies
individuals.quote: the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow.

individuals.title: Moderators configure Edit Check activation
individuals.quote: it is crucial that moderators be empowered to configure when, and for whom, Edit Check becomes activated.

individuals.title: Reference detection conditions
individuals.quote: the initial reference Edit Check becoming activated if/when all of the following conditions are met

individuals.title: Reference Check A/B Test
individuals.quote: we conducted an A/B test with 15 Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Reference Check increased edit quality
individuals.quote: Reference Check caused an **increase in the quality of edits** newcomers publish and **did not cause any significant disruption**.

individuals.title: Siderail design for Edit Check desktop
individuals.quote: This change shifted Edit Checks from appearing *within* articles to appearing *alongside* them, in a new "siderail."

individuals.title: Mobile publishing workflow step
individuals.quote: a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow that people will see if/when they add new content *without* a reference.
